title: Project Proposal and Literature Review
description: Encourages discussion of alternate approaches to project topics as well as examine the components of a project proposal, especially the features of an effective literature review. The proposal and literature review for the MEd project must be accepted by the 598A course instructor and the student's program supervisor.
notes: Students who do not complete the course requirements may register a second time for the course. Incomplete course requirements in the second term will result in a request to the Faculty of Graduate Studies for withdrawal from the program. There are appeal procedures for extenuating circumstances.
